memo: Leak-free ranker part, step 1 (data). Base: f465 pipeline (dmitriigluzdov 'The Data Behind Spectra to Structures' v16 + sanpier's PubChem promotion), engine 1 only. Ours: validation rig (build.py val=800 valfold=0 rkdump=1): 800 enveda-180 molecules of identity fold 0 (dmitriigluzdov's identity-disjoint folds) are held out of train (c1 half keeps other-library spectra, c2 half loses all), the engine FP bank is the fold-safe fpnet_fold0 (never saw fold 0), and the base ranker's input rows (top 300 + truth) are dumped to rk_rows.parquet. No submission. Why: 10-26 showed the fold-safe FPNet does not help as a drop-in (fe 0.458, fp 0.467); the base LightGBM ranker was fitted on rows where FPNet and the library had seen each molecule, so it over-trusts them on new molecules. Next: retrain the ranker on these rows (CV by molecule) and compare MRR with the base ranker on the same rows.
